entities.summary: William John Masterton was a Canadian–American professional ice hockey player who was a centre in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Minnesota North Stars in 1967–68. He is the only player in NHL history to die as a direct result of injuries suffered during a game: massive head trauma following a hit during a January 13, 1968, contest against the Oakland Seals.
